IGUI_SM_EmotionalMemory: This place is hard to forget.
IGUI_SM_OptionHideIndicatorSearchedPlace: Hide the indicator in fully searched Homes and Outposts
IGUI_SM_OptionEmotionalReactions: Apply vanilla panic and stress reactions
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberWoodStoves: Remember antique ovens and wood stoves
IGUI_SM_OptionOverlayVisibleByDefault: Show the overlay when opening the map
IGUI_SM_OptionEnabledTooltip: Turn Survivor Memory on or off. Existing memories are kept.
IGUI_SM_OptionPreferNeatUITooltip: Use NeatUI styling when the framework is active. The vanilla interface remains available.
IGUI_SM_OptionRecallPanelKeyTooltip: Assign a key to open the memory panel for your current building. No key is assigned by default.
IGUI_SM_OptionBuildingMemoryTooltip: Remember buildings actually entered, including visit dates and exploration progress.
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberRoomsTooltip: Remember rooms your character has physically entered.
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberContainersTooltip: Remember containers actually presented through the loot interface.
IGUI_SM_OptionShowStatusIndicatorTooltip: Show the memory icon while inside a remembered building.
IGUI_SM_OptionPlacesTooltip: Allow remembered buildings to carry a personal Home or Outpost designation.
IGUI_SM_OptionAllowDesignationsTooltip: Enable the actions used to mark or clear Homes and Outposts.
IGUI_SM_OptionHideIndicatorSearchedPlace: Hide the building-memory icon in fully searched Homes and Outposts.
IGUI_SM_OptionEmotionalMemoryTooltip: Remember places connected to exceptionally severe experiences.
IGUI_SM_OptionEmotionalReactionsTooltip: Revisiting a severe memory may cause one small vanilla panic and stress reaction.
IGUI_SM_OptionReactionStrengthTooltip: Adjust the strength of the one-time vanilla reaction when an emotional memory is recalled.
IGUI_SM_OptionImportantMemoryTooltip: Remember only selected, remarkable world objects that your character actually sees.
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberGeneratorsTooltip: Remember the last place where a generator was actually seen.
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberGasPumpsTooltip: Remember gas pumps only when they are visible on screen.
IGUI_SM_OptionRememberWoodStovesTooltip: Remember antique ovens and wood stoves that were actually seen.
IGUI_SM_OptionVehicleMemoryTooltip: Remember where vehicles were last encountered, never their live position.
IGUI_SM_OptionVehicleInteractionsTooltip: Record a vehicle when entering it, leaving it, or opening its mechanics interface.
IGUI_SM_OptionWorldMapOverlayTooltip: Display non-destructive Survivor Memory markers over the World Map.
IGUI_SM_OptionOverlayVisibleByDefaultToo: Enable the memory overlay automatically whenever the World Map is opened.
IGUI_SM_OptionShowPersonalPlaceMarkersTo: Show the distinct markers for personal Homes and Outposts.
IGUI_SM_OptionShowImportantMarkersToolti: Show places where remarkable objects were last seen.
IGUI_SM_OptionShowVehicleMarkersTooltip: Show vehicles at their last remembered position.
IGUI_SM_OptionMarkerSizeTooltip: Scale Survivor Memory markers from 75 to 150 percent.
